metadata.title: Spectral Beurling-Selberg Approximation and Applications to Effective Motivic Chebotarev-Sato-Tate Estimates
metadata.abstract: We establish a spectral Beurling-Selberg approximation theorem on compact connected Riemannian manifolds for sets whose boundaries have finite upper Minkowski content. Our majorants and minorants have controlled spectral coefficients and explicit stability under Hausdorff perturbations, uniformly over families satisfying a common Minkowski content bound. We extend the construction to singular spaces arising from Riemannian submetries with basic mean curvature, and apply it to equidistribution on quaternionic Shimura varieties. Assuming the conjectural formalism of the specified motivic L-functions, including the motivic Riemann hypothesis, we develop effective Chebotarev-Sato-Tate estimates for fixed sets and varying families with controlled boundary geometry and Hausdorff variation, and describe how additional symmetries improve the error exponents. The proofs combine classical analytic methods with new methods from differential geometry, analytic geometry, and Riemannian spectral analysis. Applications include an asymptotic formula for a motivic analogue of Atkin-Serre estimates and tubular estimates for Picard-rank jumps of K3 surfaces via their transcendental motives.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 紧流形谱逼近与条件性有效等分布
analysis.workSummary: 在紧、连通 Riemann 流形上，对边界上 Minkowski content 有限的集合建立谱 Beurling–Selberg 上下逼近，控制谱系数并量化 Hausdorff 扰动稳定性，常数在共同边界 content 界的集合族上一致。扩展到具有 basic mean curvature 的 Riemannian submetry 所得奇异空间，并应用于 quaternionic Shimura 簇的等分布。
techniques: 谱上下逼近与边界 Minkowski content
Riemannian submetry 与奇异谱分析
analysis.breakthrough: 把几何集合族的谱逼近误差与算术等分布问题联结，可处理随参数变化的边界及附加对称性。
analysis.limitations: 有效 motivic Chebotarev–Sato–Tate、Atkin–Serre 型及 K3 Picard-rank 应用依赖指定 motivic L-functions 的猜想形式体系，包含 motivic Riemann hypothesis；不得当作全部无条件定理。奇异推广也需 submetry/basic mean curvature 条件。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。全文关键词及断行模型名补检唯一相关命中在第67页，内容是询问能否将OpenAI他人的准Riemann假设工作推广到自守情形，不是作者自身使用AI的声明。已检查第17页完整致谢：感谢家人、导师、学者与资助机构，无自身AI工具使用披露。6个短提取页均渲染确认为实际空白页，原shortTextPages保留。这里只能认定所审PDF未见作者自身使用披露，不能推断未使用AI。另逐页查看文本过短页面的渲染图，确认仅为空白页或章节扉页。

analysis.priorityReason: 谱几何工具与奇异空间分析有独立价值，但算术应用强依赖猜想，应区分优先阅读。
